answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the nebula queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The falcon index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 779 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the beacon. Verification alone takes 6 days each. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
